prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: chr_faisca_strong, production animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 defines illustration style only; image 2 locks identity; image 3 locks body scale and anatomical proportions, NOT its background. Faisca is a slim young man with swept-back spiky white/cyan hair, long cyan and white scarf, cropped white/cyan high-collar jacket, black fingerless gloves, fitted black trousers with cyan trim, black/white sneakers with luminous cyan soles.
Heavy side strike: big anticipation twist, step in, smear frame, full-extension impact pose with a bright white-core star flash at the fist (frame 5), follow-through, recovery twice, back to guard. Exactly eight poses: 1 anticipation twist; 2 step in; 3 accelerating; 4 small clean smear; 5 full extension contact and compact white-core cyan electric star flash; 6 follow-through; 7 recovery; 8 guard. Flash completely inside cell. No other fighter or objects.
Maintain SAME body height/scale as idle reference, about 82% of cell height in upright guard; do not shrink fighter to accommodate effects. Fixed grounded sole baseline 88% cell height (translate baseline consistently from reference). Keep scarf compact as needed to fit borders.
Maximum native resolution supported, landscape 3:2, request 3456x2304 if supported, never below 1536 on longer edge. masterpiece-level key art quality, highly detailed, crisp clean linework, rich layered lighting with warm golden-hour key light and cool shadows, detailed background depth, no blur, no smudged details, no AI artifacts, no melted shapes. The background-depth phrase applies to shading richness ONLY: background must be transparent, no scenery, no gradient or glow backdrop.
Sprite sheet for a 2D side-view fighting game. Strict side view, character facing RIGHT in every frame. Grid of 4 columns × 2 rows, 8 equal cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom as frames 1 to 8 of ONE continuous animation. The SAME character in every cell: identical proportions, costume, colors and scale; only the pose changes, with smooth in-between motion from one frame to the next. Feet (or lowest point when grounded) on the same baseline at 88% of the cell height; the character's body centered horizontally in each cell; nothing crosses cell borders. Clean cel-shaded anime illustration matching the reference image: thick dark outline (#15101C), two-tone flat shading, crisp rim light in the character's accent color. Fully transparent background (if transparency is impossible, flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no gradient and no shadow). No grid lines, no frame numbers, no text, no ground, no drop shadow, no effects outside the character unless the prompt asks for them.
CORRECTION, highest priority: DO NOT reproduce the dark teal gradient background in the references. Use an entirely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, with absolutely no gradients, shadows, halos or scenery. Uniform exact 4x2 cells. Place foot soles at y=450 for top row and y=962 for bottom row in 1536x1024 normalized coordinates. Match original idle limb and head size. Frame 5 fist AND small flash must stop before x=374, within its first-column cell x=0..383. Frame 6 must remain inside x=384..767. Compress strike pose horizontally through joint articulation, never shrink body. Keep scarf and all lightning within each cell; leave 10px minimum side gutters. Frame 4 uses a short intentional motion smear only. Prioritize clean separated silhouettes and true production grid.
notes: Model identifier not exposed by tool. Requested maximum native resolution; output 1536x1024.
